args: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|[\"])config\.yaml|[\"]\.env[\"]|docker-compose\.(yml|yaml)[\"]' && echo '⚠️ 阻止编辑敏感配置文件（.env / config.yaml / docker-compose），需要改的话跟我说一声让我走安全审查流程' && exit 1 || exit 0

file="$CLAUDE_EDITED_FILE"
        case "$file" in
          */backend-go/*.go)
            pkg=$(echo "$file" | sed -n 's|.*/backend-go/internal/\(domain/[^/]*\).*|./internal/\1|p')
            if [ -n "$pkg" ]; then
              cd /Users/lc/multisell/backend-go && go vet "$pkg" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/go vet: /'
            fi
            ;;
        esac
